answer.note: The handoff proposed A and C. I changed it to D and C because the A–D ref files are identical generic notes with no file priority, so I chose from the code. honest.py (D) is the match: _verify_history (lines 175-195) rejects equal prereg and ledger commits and requires `git diff --name-only` to equal only the public digest file. I did not check whether honest.py has two arms. visibility.py (C) has a same-named _verify_history without those checks (lines 191-205), so it is the best comparison file. Suggested 60-minute split: D 35 min, C 15 min, B (heldout.verify_history) 6 min, A (study.verify_history) 4 min. Neither B nor A has the equality or diff-only-digest checks. listener.py has a similar seal-commit check (line 697) but is not a candidate file.
